create_LinearBBB_layer: create a Bayesian neural network layer using LinearBBB with configurable input output dimensions and prior variance
build_FullyConnectedProbabilisticNetwork: build a probabilistic fully connected network with configurable layers activations batch norm and dropout
run_forward_LinearBBB: run a forward pass through a LinearBBB layer to sample weights and compute log prior and posterior
calculate_sample_elbo: calculate the negative evidence lower bound loss using Monte Carlo sampling over multiple forward passes
compute_log_prior_posterior: compute the aggregate log prior and log posterior across all Bayesian linear layers in the network
